ai_launch_test_ok_ck.name: ai_launch_test_ok_ck
ai_launch_test_ok_ck.value: test_ok IS NULL OR test_ok IN (0, 1)

ai_session_tool_ck.name: ai_session_tool_ck
ai_session_tool_ck.value: length(tool) BETWEEN 2 AND 32 AND tool NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'

ai_source_tool_ck.name: ai_source_tool_ck
ai_source_tool_ck.value: length(tool) BETWEEN 2 AND 32 AND tool GLOB '[a-z]*' AND tool NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'

ai_template_tool_ck.name: ai_template_tool_ck
ai_template_tool_ck.value: tool IS NULL OR tool IN ('claude_code', 'codex')

ai_template_worktree_ck.name: ai_template_worktree_ck
ai_template_worktree_ck.value: worktree IS NULL OR worktree IN (0, 1)

hook_event_tool_ck.name: hook_event_tool_ck
hook_event_tool_ck.value: length(tool) BETWEEN 2 AND 32 AND tool NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'

task_inbox_idx.name: task_inbox_idx
task_inbox_idx.where: scheduled_date IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('todo', 'doing')

task_external_source_ck.name: task_external_source_ck
task_external_source_ck.value: external_source IS NULL OR (length(external_source) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND external_source NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._-]*')

task_external_id_ck.name: task_external_id_ck
task_external_id_ck.value: external_id IS NULL OR length(external_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256

tte_range_ck.name: tte_range_ck
tte_range_ck.value: end_at IS NULL OR end_at >= start_at
